'''TB-2954''' was the designation of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="hostage" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], TB-2954 was among those sent to retrieve a captured [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on the planet [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. Upon the orders of his [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Delaya)|officer]], TB-2954 and his squad opened fire and killed [[J'er Nahj]] and [[Halle Dray]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] who originally captured Organa. TB-2954 and [[TB-31]] were then ordered to take Organa into their temporary base for interrogation.<ref name="hostage" />
